# LidPulse 1.2.0
- 合蓋亮燈時會要求顯示器熄屏。 - 合蓋期間以設定亮度固定發光，暫停音訊分析同呼吸、音樂及 AI 燈效動畫；開蓋後恢復原本模式。 - 減少合蓋期間嘅定時更新，保留 30 分鐘上限、高溫同低電量保護。
Mac 會保持清醒，其他程式仍然可以運作；實際耗電及發熱會受其他工作影響。
---
- Requests display sleep during closed-lid lighting. - Holds your selected brightness with audio analysis and animated effects paused. Opening the lid restores your previous mode. - Reduces periodic work while preserving the 30-minute limit, thermal protection and low-battery cutoff.
Your Mac stays awake and other apps can continue running. Power consumption and heat depend on other workloads.

# LidPulse 1.1.1
- 合蓋保持發光嘅上限調整至每次 30 分鐘。 - 系統報告嚴重或危急熱壓力時，會停止合蓋亮燈並恢復正常睡眠。 - 電池供電時，電量低於 20% 亦會提早停止。
---
- Extended closed-lid lighting sessions to 30 minutes. - Sessions stop and normal sleep resumes when macOS reports serious or critical thermal pressure. - Sessions also stop below 20% charge while running on battery.

# LidPulse 1.1.0
- 新增電量模式，Logo 亮度隨電池電量調整。 - 改善合蓋亮燈，保留所選模式同亮度，毋須管理員授權。 - 合蓋保持清醒最多 10 分鐘；低電量或系統報告升溫時恢復正常睡眠。 - 新增檢查更新、自動下載及安裝，並驗證更新簽章。
合蓋亮燈會令 Mac 保持清醒，請勿放入袋中。最高亮度解鎖仍由 macOS 要求管理員授權。
---
- Added Battery mode: logo brightness follows battery charge. - Improved closed-lid lighting with your selected mode and brightness, without administrator approval. - Closed-lid sessions last up to 10 minutes and stop on low battery or elevated thermal pressure. - Added signed in-app updates with automatic checking, downloading and installation.
Closed-lid lighting keeps your Mac awake. Do not put it in a bag. Full brightness unlocking still requires macOS administrator approval.
